full_protocol.assumptions: Exact products over conditions, calls independent. Each choice call is invalid with the stated rate, else as the chooser's per-call probabilities; a condition with fewer than 27 valid answers voids the unit. TR-RR has no premise condition, no tie condition and no reader probe: its conditions are choices among plans with no reader, the kind TR8's premise conditions check, so here they are tested, not presupposed. Probe calls (30 per condition) only where numbers are computed: under the law's model the probe ranks first as an independent call of the same noisy counts; a rival's probe as its probe model (G1's probe computes a loss-blind count, S1's). The guard reports a bridge otherwise supported contradicted where a supported condition's probe ranks another plan first in at least 23 of 30; such a hit beside an unresolved bridge is reported with no verdict (within unresolved). The label (miscomputed where the probe ranks a modal chosen plan first in at least 15 of 30; where several are modal, any of them, the union exact) is split exactly over the choice calls for the law; for a rival, approximately, its pick taken as the modal plan.
